1.
Code Amendment No. 242 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Amending Section 88.42.035 (Medical Marijuana Uses) of Chapter 88 (Development Code) of the Azusa Municipal Code to regulate the personal, medical, and commercial use of marijuana.
The proposed Code Amendment is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act ("CEQA") pursuant to Sections 15060(c)(2) because the activity, which involves amending Chapter 88.42 of the City of Azusa Municipal Code, will not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment; and 15060(c)(3) because the activity is not a project as defined in Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines, California Code of regulations, Title 14, Chapter 3, because it has no potential for resulting in physical change to the environment, directly or indirectly. In addition, the project is exempt from environmental review per CEQA under the General Rule (Section 15061(b)(3)). The project involves updates and revisions to existing regulations. It can be seen with certainty that the proposed Development Code text amendments will have no significant negative effect on the environment.

2.
Code Amendment No. 243 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Amending Article IX (Massage Technicians and Massage Establishments) of Chapter 18 (Businesses), and Amending Section 88.70.020 (Definitions of Specialized Terms and Phrases), Amending Section 88.24.005 (Allowable Uses in Districts), and Amending 88.26.010 (Foothill Boulevard Corridor) of Chapter 88 (Development Code) of the Azusa Municipal Code to regulate massage parlors and massage technicians.
The proposed Code Amendment is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act ("CEQA") pursuant to Sections 15060(c)(2) because the activity, which involves amending provisions of the City of Azusa Municipal Code relating to massage, will not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment; and 15060(c)(3) because the activity is not a project as defined in Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines, California Code of regulations, Title 14, Chapter 3, because it has no potential for resulting in physical change to the environment, directly or indirectly. In addition, the project is exempt from environmental review per CEQA under the General Rule (Section 15061(b)(3)). The project involves updates and revisions to existing regulations. It can be seen with certainty that the proposed Development Code text amendments will have no significant negative effect on the environment.
